mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, password, nickname, phone_number, role, fcm_token, provider, provider_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{phoneNumber}, #{role}, #{fcmToken}, #{provider}, #{providerId}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
